title: The Full Argument
blurb: The whole mother-son showdown in one take. Over a minute of fury.

characters.name: Penelope
characters.description: Twenty years holding the throne alone. Furious.

characters.name: Telemachus
characters.description: Her son, back from Sparta with a desperate plan.

lines.direction: Stunned. Then furious. Stand up straight.

lines.text: If you remarry, the other suitors will leave, and then I'm only dealing with one of them. I'm almost of age.
lines.direction: Calm and rehearsed. You practiced this speech.

lines.text: I'll tell the elders that I learned of Odysseus's death in Sparta. Menelaus will back me up, and they'll let me assume the throne.
lines.direction: Lower your voice: this is the dangerous part.

lines.text: So you deny your father, and I leave my home and go live with one of these snakes? That's your plan.
Would you have a better one?
Lock the door, set a fire, and burn the bastards.
lines.direction: Deadly calm. Then spit the last words.

lines.text: Do you think if I remarry, life goes back to the way it was?
lines.direction: Softer now. Make him see it.

lines.text: That world is gone, and in this one, they're not giving up power to you or Odysseus.
lines.direction: Grip the table. Every word is a blade.

lines.text: If he returned, he'd have to kill them, like you will.
lines.direction: Point at him: this is his fate too.

lines.text: If I kill them, their families will demand revenge. I'd be exiled,
lines.direction: Pacing. You've thought about this every night.

lines.text: and without me, the throne will be lost.
'Cause only a man can sit on it.
I've been sitting on that empty throne for 20 years.
lines.direction: Hand on your chest. Twenty years of anger.

lines.text: My knowledge, my years of experience, that's all nothing compared to the bristles on your chin.

source: The Odyssey (2026 film); OBS screen recording, transcribed with ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (diarized)
